concept: SQS: buffer between web tier and workers + Auto Scaling on queue depth
tests: How to absorb unpredictable load spikes and decouple order processing from the web tier.
expected: SQS queue between the web tier and order processors + EC2 Auto Scaling on queue depth (ApproximateNumberOfMessages / backlog per instance). Triggers: "unpredictable spikes", "flash sales", "decouple order processing".
why_not: A fixed fleet and synchronous processing in a single RDS can't handle bursts; keeping orders in instance memory means data loss.
